description:
## Scope
Migrate lib/jido_ai.ex generate_text/2, generate_object/3, stream_text/2 and model helpers; actions/{llm,planning,reasoning,tool_calling}/ and helpers.ex; directive/{llm_generate,llm_stream,llm_embed,helpers}.ex. Add backend-aware options while preserving existing arities and return/error behavior.
Keep native ReqLLM.StreamResponse from default stream_text/2; add stream_format: :backend returning portable Stream for every backend. Generic facade unwraps adapter-native export without calling ReqLLM itself; all internal consumers keep portable handles. Strip stream-format/routing options before execution.
Add backend fields to action/directive schemas and context defaults. Carry Ref explicitly into async tasks. Tool-calling actions must retain backend/options through EVERY post-tool generation. Translate normalized embeddings into existing action/directive shapes; maintain usage/signal contracts. Shared pure Response/Message/Tool/Schema helpers remain allowed.
Model labels and fingerprints must use the selected backend rather than ReqLLM globally. Provider-specific option discovery resides only in adapter; public compatibility helpers delegate.

## Acceptance criteria
- Default facade/action/directive characterization suites remain green.
- Custom-backend tests cover text/object/embedding, streaming and multi-round tools.
- Async directives receive exact backend selection and options.
- Default native stream return and explicit portable mode both work.
- New boundary errors use existing sanitization/envelope conventions.

## Suggested commit
refactor(ai): route facades actions and directives through backends

comments.text: Facades generate_text/generate_object/stream_text, model helpers, actions (LLM/planning/reasoning/tool calling), and async generation/stream/embedding directives now dispatch through selected backend. Default facade stream retains native ReqLLM.StreamResponse; stream_format: :backend portable; custom backend tested through facades/actions/directives and multi-round tool followups. ReqLLM adapter normalizes map-shaped legacy test fixtures into shared ReqLLM.Response rather than weakening the custom backend result contract. Full stable suite: 31 doctests + 2502 tests, zero failures (1 excluded); changed files format checked, warnings-as-errors compile passes. Selection propagation from agent/request/plugin/other strategies and ReAct remains in .5/.6. User AGENTS.md and .serena/ untouched.

title: Route facades, actions and directives through backend dispatch
